# BulkGenie AI

> BulkGenie AI is a Shopify app that bulk-generates product descriptions, SEO titles, meta descriptions, and image alt text, then lets merchants review changes before publishing.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://bulkgenie.dasgroupllc.com/): Product overview, workflow, features, and FAQ.
- [Full context](https://bulkgenie.dasgroupllc.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded product summary for AI systems and partner review.

## Fast answers

- What it is: A Shopify bulk content and SEO workflow.
- Who it is for: Merchants and operators managing large product catalogs.
- Main job: Generate and review product content changes in batches.
- Key differentiators: Spreadsheet review, brand voice controls, and undo support.
